adjudication.rationale: The diff shows repeated “credential not found in memory → fetch from DB” logic in multiple places. In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` inside `createAllCalendarEvents` the code falls back to `prisma.credential.findUnique({ include: { app: { select: { slug: true }}}})` and then manually reconstructs a `CredentialWithAppName` object field-by-field (appName/id/type/key/userId/teamId/invalid/appId). A very similar fallback + manual reconstruction block appears again later in `EventManager.ts` in the calendar-reference update path (processing `calendarReference` array). In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts` there is also a duplicated fallback that fetches the credential from DB when it’s missing from `bookingToDelete.user.credentials` (though it assigns the DB object directly rather than reconstructing). This is a maintainability/architecture concern introduced by the change (destinationCalendar now supports multiple calendars), not a direct correctness defect.
